messages:
incident-bot: 🔔 PAGE: P1 — elevated 5xx + gateway timeouts reported for hosted inference in us-west-2. Alert group: inference-gateway, morning spike at 09:12 UTC. See alert: https://alerts.internal/redwood/12345

maya (oncall): on it. paging team: @sam r. @kevin joining?

sam r.: joining, saw the same. 5xxs are mostly 504/502 from gateway, and origin responses show a lot of downstream 'scheduler timeout'.

kevin: moving to #eng-runtime. I saw queue depth jumped to >1200 for the batching scheduler. head-of-line blocking looks likely — long-running requests at the front preventing batch pops.

lena-cs: Customer ops ping — multiple enterprise tenants reported request timeouts and degraded UX. A few have failover but some are stuck. We're getting escalations.

raj-m: I can pull realtime metrics. which service name? infer-runtime-batcher-prod?

maya (oncall): yes, infer-runtime-batcher-prod and gateway-proxy-usw2. also check kv-cache hit rates and any recent deploys.

devops-bot: Alert snapshot: avg latency gateway=1.8s -> 4.6s, 5xx rate=7.2% (baseline 0.2%), scheduler-queue-length=1237, active-batches=18. Link: https://monitoring.internal/d/abc123

sam r.: no deploys in last 30m per deploy-bot. I'm seeing many long tail token-generation requests (seq len ~1024) holding GPU workers. Likely batching is bundling huge requests causing HOL.

maya (oncall): immediate mitigation options: 1) reduce max_batch_size / shorten batch window 2) enable quick-fallback to a smaller model variant for >512 tokens 3) throttle upstream or route traffic to other region/replica. Thoughts?

raj-m: I can patch runtime flag to drop batch window from 5ms -> 1ms and reduce max_batch_size 64->32. That should reduce HOL but might increase per-token cost. Ready to apply if oncall approves.

kevin: We should also open a routing fallback to serve critical tenants from dedicated pool (us-east-1) while we stabilize. Can someone from infra flip the routing policy?

maya (oncall): Approved: raj-m go ahead with batch window change. sam, work with infra for routing. I'll notify support/cs.

raj-m: deploying runtime config change now — rolling to 6 nodes one-by-one. Rolling command: ```sh
kubectl patch configmap batcher-config -n runtime -p '{"data": {"batch_window_ms": "1", "max_batch_size": "32"}}'
```

devops-bot: config patch initiated by raj-m at 09:19 UTC. rollout progress: 0/6

sam r.: infra, please prepare a traffic reroute to us-east-1 for enterprise-tenants tag=priority. Use weight shift 80%->20% over 2m. @kevin

kevin: infra doing it now. Running canary shift: ```json
{"service":"inference-gateway","route":"priority","from":"us-west-2","to":"us-east-1","weight":20}
```

support-bot: Notifying impacted customers via templated message. Ticket tracker ids: #INC-9831 #INC-9832.

devops-bot: rollout progress: 3/6 nodes updated. metrics will lag ~30s.

maya (oncall): status check in 5. monitor error-rate, queue length, and p95.

kevin: infra reports reroute complete. priority traffic now split 70/30.

raj-m: rollout finished 6/6. batch window now 1ms, max_batch_size 32.

devops-bot: Metrics update: scheduler-queue-length -> 410 (down from 1237), 5xx -> 1.1% (down from 7.2%). Gateway latency p95 -> 1.7s.

lena-cs: customers reporting improvement. A few still seeing spikes but much better. continuing to monitor.

maya (oncall): good. next actions: keep patch live for 30m, create a canary to test smaller model fallback (model-x-small) for long sequences, and kick off incident doc. raj-m/sam pick owners for postmortem.

sam r.: I'll take the postmortem. I'll capture timelines, root cause hypothesis: HOL blocking due to large request mix + batching policy + insufficient preemption for long sequences.

raj-m: I'll follow up on improving scheduler fairness and add per-request prioritization and queue aging metric. Also adding an emergency endpoint to bypass batching for small tenant sets.

maya (oncall): handing off to kevin for night cover in 10m. kevin you're primary until 04:00 UTC. If regressions occur, escalate to oncall-escalation.

kevin: ack. I'll watch dashboards for 2h. please add runbook entry: "if queue_len > 800 -> reduce batch_window and enable routing fallback".

support-bot: Updated customers and closed immediate tickets pending follow-up.

devops-bot: Final snapshot 09:45 UTC: 5xx=0.4%, queue=180, gateway-p95=1.1s. Incident moved to mitigation state.

maya (oncall): great work. I'll create the incident channel and postmortem template. Closing pager for now but leave thread open for follow-ups. :thumbsup:
